mines.mine_notes: Definitive Feasibility Study underway (Worley appointed engineering contractor Apr 2025); construction decision targeted H2 2026. No mineral reserves declared; no published economic study figures yet. M&I MRE grades: 59 g/t Ag, 0.51 g/t Au. Phases IV (21,172 m, 106 holes) completed; Phase V drilling continued through 2025. Also holds La Coipita earn-in/JV option with Teck (Teck can earn 80%). FY2025 net loss C$57.6M; no revenue.
mines.processing: Dual processing route envisioned: tank leach for high-grade oxides + maiden heap leach for low-grade oxides (low-cost recovery route)

notes: Advanced-stage developer (no production). Flagship is 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project (Salta province, Argentina; five deposits: Oculto, JAC, Fantasma, Laderas, Sombra). Graduated from TSXV to TSX Feb 24, 2025. MD&A in CAD. Updated MRE effective July 21, 2025 (announced Jul 29, 2025); Technical Report filed Sept 12, 2025. Note: a post-FY updated MRE was announced May 6, 2026 (232 Mt M&I, 248 Moz Ag, 2.54 Moz Au, 454 Moz AgEq) — not used here as it is outside the FY.
report_title: Management's Discussion and Analysis Year ended December 31, 2025

reserves_resources.notes: Tank leach oxides; 327.1 Moz AgEq. Constrained within conceptual Whittle open pit (US$27.50/oz Ag, US$2,400/oz Au; 80% Ag / ~% Au tank-leach recovery). Resources not reserves.
Maiden heap leach oxides MRE; 22.8 Moz AgEq. Constrained within conceptual Whittle open pit (US$27.50/oz Ag, US$2,400/oz Au; 80% Ag, 58% Au heap-leach recovery). Previously classified as waste.
